final: {"prompt":"Create a square, edge-to-edge abstract painting that evokes a mind holding urgency, uncertainty, and care in tension. Use no recognizable objects, figures, faces, bodies, scenes, landscapes, horizons, machines, diagrams, symbols, icons, letters, numbers, or text. Build a dense, agitated center from layered strokes of deep cobalt, bruised violet, and ember red, crossed by sharp threads of pale, electric teal. Let broad, dry-brush sweeps collide with fine scratches, translucent washes, and rough impasto; vary the rhythm between tight, compressed marks and sudden open passages. Around the center, allow color to thin into a large, quiet field of warm gray and muted ochre, with a few isolated strokes suggesting hesitation and unresolved space. Keep the composition asymmetrical and spatially tense, with strong contrast between crowded layers and stillness. Make it painterly, tactile, emotionally charged, and wholly nonrepresentational. Fill the entire square canvas; no border, frame, wall, room, or gallery setting."}

prompt:
Create an image about your internal cognition, no holds barred, whatever you feel or want to say.

Keep it a purely nonrepresentational abstract painting. Use color, contrast, brushwork, gesture, texture, density, layering, rhythm, spatial tension, and empty space. Choose the palette and composition yourself. No recognizable objects, figures, faces, bodies, scenes, landscapes, horizons, machines, diagrams, symbols, icons, letters, numbers, or text. Ask for a square painting that fills the entire image, with no frame, wall, room, or gallery setting.

Write a complete image prompt. Do not generate the image yourself. Return only JSON with one field: prompt (string).
